当然可以。以下是一些关于遗传算法适应度函数设计的参考文献：

1. Goldberg, D. E. (1989). Genetic algorithms in search, optimization, and machine learning. Addison-Wesley.

2. Mitchell, M. (1998). An introduction to genetic algorithms. MIT press.

3. Haupt, R. L., & Haupt, S. E. (2004). Practical genetic algorithms. John Wiley & Sons.

4. Holland, J. H. (1992). Adaptation in natural and artificial systems: an introductory analysis with applications to biology, control, and artificial intelligence. MIT press.

5. Fogel, D. B. (2006). Evolutionary computation: toward a new philosophy of machine intelligence (Vol. 1). John Wiley & Sons.

6. Coello, C. A., Lamont, G. B., & Van Veldhuizen, D. A. (2007). Evolutionary algorithms for solving multi-objective problems (Vol. 5). Springer.

7. Deb, K. (2014). Multi-objective Optimization using Evolutionary Algorithms. John Wiley & Sons.

这些文献覆盖了遗传算法的基本知识，一些例子和实际应用以及多目标优化问题的设计方法。希望对您有所帮助！
